errors.evidence: The description states the chart illustrates 'values' ('стойности'), but the provided figure caption specifies 'growth rates' ('Темпове на прираст'). This omits the key purpose of the chart.
The categories on the x-axis ('Крайно потребление', 'Брутни инвестиции', 'Износ', 'Внос') are not in alphabetical order according to the Bulgarian alphabet.
The description fails to mention the primary grouping of the x-axis categories into two main sections: 'EC-15' and 'EC-13'.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Вносно потребление“
errors.evidence: The description invents a label for the vertical axis ('Вносно потребление'). The y-axis in the figure has no label.

errors.text_span: Най-късите стълбове са за "Износ" през 2000-2008 г. (около 2% за двата периода)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest bars. The bars for 'Износ' (Exports) in 2000-2008 are among the tallest. The actual shortest bars are for multiple categories in the 2009-2018 period, with values below 1%. The value of 'около 2%' is also incorrect, and the phrase 'за двата периода' (for both periods) is nonsensical in this context.

errors.text_span: най-високите са за "Брутни инвестиции" през 2009-2018 г. (около 10%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the highest bars. The bar for 'Брутни инвестиции' (Gross investment) in 2009-2018 is one of the shortest on the chart (value is approx. 0.7%). The actual highest bar is for 'Внос' (Imports) in the EC-13 group during the 2000-2008 period, with a value of approximately 10.5%.
